scene_sentences: Prepare ingredients for Tomato Cucumber Salad with Mint: red wine vinegar, white sugar, salt, cucumber, tomato, onion, mint, olive oil, salt pepper.
Step 1 of Tomato Cucumber Salad with Mint: In a large bowl, combine vinegar, sugar, and salt. Mix in cucumbers, and marinate 1 hour, stirring occasionally..
Step 2 of Tomato Cucumber Salad with Mint: Gently toss tomatoes, onion, mint, and olive oil with the marinated cucumbers. Season with salt and pepper..
